A.span: And other actions will be left undone Or else will bear a meager fruit.
A.explanation: Conflates 'other actions' and the 'former action', omits 'time of the result', and mistranslates 'inferior'.

D.explanation: Mistranslates 'གཞན་' (other [deeds]) as an adverb 'Furthermore', omitting the reference to other deeds.

A.explanation: Translates 'རྣམ་པར་རྟོག་པ་' (discursive thought), conflating it with distraction (རྣམ་པར་གཡེང་བ་).

B.explanation: Misinterprets the prefix 'རྣམ་པར་' (vi-) in 'རྣམ་པར་གཡེང་བ་' (distraction) as the adjective 'Complete'.

C.span: Of what in truth is nothing but a heap of bones
C.explanation: Omits the conditional 'ན་' (if) and loosely translates 'ཀེང་རུས་' (skeleton) as 'heap of bones'.

C.span: Is this the only object of desire and lust? Sooner pass beyond all suffering and grief!
C.explanation: Significantly distorts the source syntax and mistranslates 'ཅི་ཕྱིར་མྱ་ངན་འདས་མི་འགྲོ།' (why do you not go to nirvana?).

A.span: your need is no more there
A.explanation: Inaccurately introduces a temporal change ('no more there') for 'དགོས་པ་མེད་ན་' (if there is no need).
Incorrectly merges 'འདོད་པས་' (by sensual desire) and 'འཚོ་འདོད་' (wishing to make a living), mistranslating the former.

A.span: Decide that they will make their fortune In the wars,
A.explanation: Distorts the meaning; the Tibetan says they enter battle while thinking 'I will make a living'.

D.explanation: Adds 'now', which is not in the Tibetan source.

A.explanation: Adds a synonymous phrase not present in the Tibetan 'ལས་འདི་བྱས་' (done this work).

D.explanation: Omits 'ཡང་' (Even) from 'གཞན་གྱིས་ཉེས་པ་བྱས་པ་ཡང་' (Even when others commit a fault).
Adds 'these same' and pluralizes 'illusion', which is singular and unmodified in the source.

D.span: objects have another mode of being
D.explanation: Translates 'gzhan yod' (there exists another [entity]) as 'another mode of being', missing the argument that the object is a different entity.

B.explanation: Translates 'bras bu (result) specifically as 'merit', which slightly narrows the term.

B.span: When Buddhas are considered truly real.
B.explanation: Translates 'toward a true Buddha' as a conditional clause about considering them real, shifting the meaning from ontology to epistemology.

D.explanation: Omits 'rung ste' (it is acceptable / suitable), missing the primary logical assertion of the clause.

A.explanation: Translates 'one would fear anything' as 'terrors will torment it', reversing the subject and object of the fear.

A.span: What is there left for fears to terrify?
A.explanation: Translates 'who is it that is afraid?' as 'what is there left for fears to terrify?', again wrongly making fear the agent.
Translates 'bye brag' (particulars) exclusively as 'kinds of mind', illogically excluding the unconscious entities mentioned in the previous line.

B.span: Because a collection, too, lacks an entity,
B.explanation: This is a dependent clause incorrectly punctuated as a standalone sentence, creating a fragment.

C.explanation: Translates a passive phrase ('as was analyzed') with an active 'we have shown', a minor stylistic shift.
Translates 'med pa nyid' (do not exist) as 'have no true existence', introducing a slight philosophical shift.

B.span: what is there to displease, what is there to please
B.explanation: The transitive verbs 'please' and 'displease' are used awkwardly without objects.

C.explanation: Changes the states of being displeased/pleased into active verbs 'give joy and pain' and adds the pronoun 'me'.

B.explanation: Adds a specific object pronoun 'them' not present in the Tibetan.

D.explanation: Translates the proper noun/specific entity 'Mara' (bdud) as generic 'evil forces'.
Translates 'brgal' (cross over) as 'dissipate', which is a slightly looser stylistic choice.

C.explanation: Translates 'minds be tender toward one another' as 'help each other', changing a mental state into a physical action.

B.explanation: Translates 'gro' (wanderers/beings) as 'others', resulting in a minor semantic shift.

D.explanation: Adds the time word 'now', which is absent in the source text.
Adds the adjective 'high' to modify intention.
